units.source_text: 女人被挫得没了气性，不仅对男人的举动，而且对男人的语言也十分顺从。

en.t: The woman had been so worn down that her spirit was gone, and she submitted not only to the man's actions but also to his words.

units.source_text: 她脸上竟然没有一点敌意或者抗议的神色。

en.t: There was not the slightest trace of hostility or protest on her face.

units.source_text: 简直像进入了一种催眠的状态。

en.t: It was almost as if she had entered a hypnotic state.

units.source_text: 男人自己也觉得，这手法不怎么高明，谁知反而表现出了暴力的效果，夺走了女人的抵抗力。

en.t: The man himself thought the method was not especially clever, yet somehow it had the effect of violence and robbed the woman of her power to resist.

units.source_text: 他把女人推出了泥地间。

en.t: He pushed the woman out into the muddy space.

units.source_text: 用另一根绑腿布捆住了女人的脚踝。

en.t: With another strip of legging cloth, he bound the woman's ankles.

units.source_text: 一切都是在暗中摸索着干的，所以，以防万一，他用剩下的绳子又捆了一道。

en.t: Everything had been done by feel in the dark, so as a precaution he tied another binding with the remaining rope.
